families.hypothesis: Ang-Chen-Xing downside-beta premium: investors demand compensation for beta measured on days BTC falls, so long high beta-minus. For upside beta the textbook direction is long LOW beta-plus. Harvey-Siddique: investors pay up for positive coskewness with BTC, so long NEGATIVE coskew. Each factor was also tested in the flipped direction. The other side would be leverage-constrained or crash-averse holders who overpay for coins that hold up in BTC sell-offs.

Fixed: weekly rebalance, hype_universe top_k=50 ex-BTC, HYPE_COST, funding charged as cost. Plus 4 post-hoc diagnostics (BAB-BN 90/180; bminus residualized on beta, flip BN 90/180). Total 36 trials.

The only cell that clears the bar is A_bminus_90_FLIP_BN (long LOW downside beta, beta-neutral, Sharpe 1.17), and it is betting-against-beta in disguise: loading on BAB-BN(90) is 0.35 (t 7.3) and residual alpha t is 1.09. Downside beta, upside beta and coskewness vs BTC are not priced beyond plain beta in this universe.

families.hypothesis: Cross-sectional vol shape predicts returns. (1) Term structure (vts, ATR ratio): vol spikes are attention shocks that later underperform, so long compressed and short expanded. (2) Vol-of-vol (Baltussen et al. 'unknown unknowns'): uncertainty about risk is negatively priced, so long low VoV. families.family: A - Cross-sectional seasonality (Heston-Sadka style): A1 weekday on 1d, A2 4h slot-of-day, A3 8h/12h session blocks
families.hypothesis: Coins that did well relative to peers on a given weekday, or in a given intraday slot, keep doing so. The proposed cause is recurring coin-specific calendar flows: fixed-weekday unlocks or reward payouts, and region-specific trading hours (Asia-heavy vs US-heavy coins). Liquidity providers absorb these flows. The effect can persist only if it is smaller than the cost of harvesting it, because the book rotates fully every bar.

A1 (1d): N in {8,13,26,52} same weekdays x {raw, excess = same-slot mean minus all-bar trailing mean} x {8L/8S, rank-proportional} = 16, plus 3 robustness (top_k 30/75, q=0.2). A2 (4h): N in {7,14,30,60} days x same 2 variants x same 2 selections = 16, plus 3 robustness. A3 (4h, added after the A2 diagnostics, pre-registered before running): block 8h/12h x N {30,60} x {raw, excess}, 8L/8S, held with drift = 8. Universe hype_universe('1d', top_k=50), mapped to 4h with the previous daily close. Cost HYPE_COST plus funding. Cost-free diagnostics: rank-IC of the raw, excess and other-slot placebo scores.

The excess score's positive IC (t about 3) comes from the other-days reversal part (placebo IC -0.025, t -4). Gross Sharpe is at most 0.83, and net is between -0.5 and -1.7 (turnover about 540/yr, cost 31-38%/yr). A2 4h slot: a real, well-identified anomaly. Raw IC is +0.018 (t 8.4) at N=60. Gross Sharpe is 3.44 (+85%/yr gross, gross alpha t 6.6 vs momentum and BTC, positive gross every year). A 24h lag keeps gross Sharpe at 3.7, while a 4h or 8h lag gives about -1.9, so the effect is slot-specific. The excess version has 0.03 correlation with momentum. But turnover is about 3200/yr and break-even cost is 2.6 bp/side vs 6.5 bp on HYPE, so net Sharpe is -5 to -10 in every config. Month-start inflows (salary-day DCA, monthly plans) and month-end window dressing or rebalancing would create a turn-of-month premium. Fixed-weight allocators would sell this month's winner into month-end. TradFi re-opening on Monday would create Monday flows. The other side is anyone forced to trade into scheduled flows. families.hypothesis: Alts beat BTC, and an alt basket earns its premium, in an 'idiosyncratic rotation' regime: high cross-sectional dispersion, low average pairwise correlation, broad breadth. Capital and retail attention flow into alt stories, and the flows persist through herding. In low-dispersion or high-correlation regimes alts move as one block with BTC and bleed against it (beta > 1, funding paid by leveraged alt longs, constant unlock supply). The regime exists only at market level, so no single-name arbitrage removes it.

candidates.name: B1_disp7_TERC - dispersion-timed alts-vs-BTC spread
candidates.rationale: High weekly cross-sectional dispersion marks an alt-rotation regime: capital and retail attention flow into alt stories and the flows persist, so EW alts beat BTC over the next 1-4 weeks. Low dispersion means alts trade as one high-beta block that bleeds against BTC (funding paid by leveraged alt longs, constant unlock supply). The regime is visible only at market level, so it is hard to arbitrage away. Both sides of the timing pay: the forward 7d spread averages +1.9% in the favourable state and -0.8% otherwise.
candidates.rules: Daily at the 00:00 UTC close. Universe U = lab.hype_universe('1d', top_k=50): HYPE coins ranked by 30d median quote volume, min 60d history. Signal disp7_t = cross-sectional std of ln(close_t/close_{t-7}) over U members. p_t = percentile of disp7_t within its own trailing 365 days (min 120 obs). State: +1 when p > 2/3, -1 when p < 1/3, otherwise keep the previous state. Position: state +1 = long all U alts (ex BTC) equal-weight, total +0.5, and short BTC -0.5. State -1 = the reverse (short alts EW -0.5, long BTC +0.5). Gross 1.0, $-neutral. Daily re-equalization; weekly rebalance gave Sharpe 1.60. No stops; exits only on a state flip. 60 switches in 4.5y, average spell 27 days, favourable 51% of the time.
candidates.inputs_used: close only for the signal (7d log returns of HYPE top-50 members); qv only for the lab liquidity-universe ranking. No funding, OI, LS, premium, spot or taker fields. Funding is charged only as a cost.
candidates.sample: IS 2020-07..2024-12 (after the 120d percentile warm-up), HYPE top-50, 1646 days, HYPE_COST 0.065%/side plus Binance funding
candidates.concerns: (1) 2024 is weak: TERC -6% (SR -0.14), and every small-book version is negative in 2024 (16-pos -17%, 11-pos -20%). The edge may be fading. (2) It needs breadth: top30 1.08, top50 1.38, top75 1.53. The 16-position version (15 alts + BTC, Sharpe 1.05, 2x cost 0.95, lag1 1.04, DSR 0.42) needs about $300 at gross 1. The $200 / $10-minimum version (10 alts + BTC) is only 0.91 (2023-24 0.21). (3) Survivorship inflates the alt basket. On the 14 legacy majors only (survival nearly certain ex-ante) it is 0.84 (all sub-periods positive, 2x cost 0.73, lag1 0.89); with the signal also computed on the majors it is 0.58 with 2022 negative. (4) With coins younger than 180d removed from the dispersion calc, 2023-24 drops to 0.49, so new-listing frenzies drive part of the signal. (5) Only about 30 regime episodes; DSR 0.68 at 53 trials, 0.60 at all 95. (6) Leg view: long side 1.37 / short side -0.52 just reflect the market direction. The real decomposition is long-spread days SR 1.64 (+49%/yr) vs short-spread days SR 1.02 (+21%/yr), alt leg 0.95 vs BTC leg -0.17. Positives: corr 0.03 to BTC and 0.07 to xsmom14 (not momentum, so additive to RMF/RNT); alpha t 2.9 after xsmom14, BTC, spread TS-mom 7/30 and BTC-vol controls; slow signal (lag 3 Sharpe 1.59, lag 5 1.28) that suits a daily GitHub Actions cron on HYPE candles with no VPS.
